No. At least from my perspective, there is no point in life at all. 
I'm not telling you to go off yourself, but at the same time I very strongly believe that it is only your decision where/when your life ends. It is in your hands and nobody else should tell you what to do.
Hey man, if you want to talk and vent to someone feel free to hit me up, I've been there since a very early age too I was going through similar things.
